Description: Identified a Private Key, which may compromise cryptographic security and sensitive data encryption.
Author: Stephanie Nwankwo
Message:
refactor: reorganize API into versioned structure (v1/v2 with shared)

Restructure backend to support multiple API versions without conflicts:
- Move all feature modules to api/v1/ (admin, agent, auth, buyer, etc.)
- Extract shared guards/decorators to api/shared/ for reuse across versions
- Create v1.app.module.ts bundling all v1 features
- Create v2.app.module.ts as placeholder for future v2 endpoints
- Update all import paths (infrastructure, interfaces, events, guards, decorators)
- Routes remain at /api/v1/... (NestJS versioning configured)

Benefits:
- v1 and v2 can coexist without interference
- Clients choose version: /api/v1/endpoint vs /api/v2/endpoint
- v2 can reuse v1 services; only controllers/DTOs differ
- Simpler onboarding for API consumers

Build: ✅ Compiles with zero errors
